title: Simple Past — Regular -AR Verbs
main_grammar: pretérito perfeito de verbos regulares em -ar.

student.lets_begin: Produce at least five accurate sentences and answer at least three questions on the topic “Activities you completed yesterday” using this lesson’s target structure.
student.english_comparison: English simple past often takes -ed; Portuguese endings vary with subject.

multiple_choice.instruction: Choose one option for each meaning; say the chosen sentence aloud.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “We talked at night.”?
Which sentence expresses “They traveled on Saturday.”?

gap_fill.instruction: Complete the missing target form. The English meaning is provided to remove ambiguity; read each whole sentence aloud.

mini_reading.instruction: Read the text aloud. Then answer the questions in full sentences.
mini_reading.text: Ontem eu trabalhei de manhã e estudei à noite. Minha irmã comprou um livro. Nós conversamos depois do jantar. Meu amigo viajou no sábado. Eu preparei café e organizei meus cadernos. O professor explicou uma palavra nova.

review.another_way_to_understand_it: Use yesterday or last week to anchor a completed action.
review.compare: Eu trabalho / Eu trabalhei ontem: routine versus completed event.

oral_substitution_drill.instruction: Start from the base sentence. Say the new sentence in Portuguese for the English cue, without writing it first.

translate.instruction: Translate into Portuguese and say each sentence aloud.

fill_in.instruction: Fill the missing form in a two-clause context; say both sentences together. The English hint gives the meaning of the second sentence.

items.sentence: Eles viajaram no sábado. Nós ________ à noite.
Você comprou um livro? Eles ________ no sábado.
Eu falei com meu amigo. Você ________ um livro?
Eu trabalhei ontem. Eu ________ com meu amigo.

listen_and_translate.instruction: Listen to three short utterances read by your teacher. Say the meaning in English, then repeat each utterance aloud.

reading_aloud_and_translation.instruction: Read the text aloud, translate it orally into English, then answer the questions.
reading_aloud_and_translation.text: Na sexta-feira, Ana visitou a família. Ela conversou com a mãe e ajudou o pai. Depois preparou o almoço. Eu trabalhei em casa. À noite, nós estudamos português e escutamos música brasileira. Todos descansaram no sábado.
questions: O que eles escutaram à noite?

speaking_practice.instruction: Answer in order: factual answers first, then personal examples and explanations. All answers are spoken in full sentences.

questions.question: Com quem você conversou ontem?
questions.english: Whom did you talk with yesterday?

questions.question: Você preparou uma refeição ontem?
questions.english: Did you prepare a meal yesterday?

questions.question: Você visitou alguém na semana passada?
questions.english: Did you visit anyone last week?

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Which sentence expresses “I worked yesterday.”? A. Você comprou um livro? B. Nós conversamos à noite. C. Eu trabalhei ontem.
A_multiple_choice.worked_answer: C. Eu trabalhei ontem. — compare the exact meaning, then read it aloud.

B_gap_fill.worked_answer: trabalhei → Eu trabalhei ontem. — use the English hint and the rest of the sentence.

C_english_to_portuguese.worked_answer: Nós conversamos à noite. — identify the subject, choose the verb form, then say it.

D_portuguese_to_english.worked_answer: I worked yesterday. — translate the meaning, not word for word.

E_reading_comprehension.worked_answer: Ela comprou um livro. — find the sentence in the text that gives the answer, then answer in a full sentence.

F_written_production.instruction: Write one new sentence with the target form, using “Eles viajaram no sábado.” as a reference.
F_written_production.worked_answer: Model: Você comprou um livro? — change the information, keep the target structure correct.

G_speaking.instruction: Say one sentence with today’s structure about your own life.
G_speaking.worked_answer: Model: Eu falei com meu amigo. — say it, then change one real-life detail.

your_homework.instruction: Give independent answers and speak all written sentences once.

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Choose the sentence with the given meaning.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “We talked at night.”?
Which sentence expresses “They traveled on Saturday.”?
Which sentence expresses “Did you buy a book?”?
Which sentence expresses “I talked to my friend.”?

E_reading.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions in full sentences.
E_reading.text: No último fim de semana, Pedro viajou para outra cidade. Ele comprou um presente e caminhou no centro. Sua irmã ficou em casa e estudou português. Eu telefonei para Pedro no domingo. Nós conversamos sobre a viagem e planejamos uma visita.
questions: O que a irmã de Pedro estudou?
Quando o narrador telefonou para Pedro?

F_written_production.instruction: Write 80–120 words on the topic “Activities you completed yesterday”. Use at least three different relevant examples of the target structure; add context and original details.

G_speaking.instruction: Record one uninterrupted spoken response to these three lesson prompts — O que você estudou ontem? / Você trabalhou no sábado? / Com quem você conversou ontem? — giving complete sentences and without reading a script.

spaced_review.prompt: I am going to work tomorrow.

teacher.pronunciation_focus: Stress the final syllable of trabalhei and estudou.

mini_reading.translation: Yesterday I worked in the morning and studied at night. My sister bought a book. We talked after dinner. My friend traveled on Saturday. I made coffee and organized my notebooks. The teacher explained a new word.

fill_in.full_sentence: Eles viajaram no sábado. Nós conversamos à noite.
Você comprou um livro? Eles viajaram no sábado.
Eu falei com meu amigo. Você comprou um livro?
Eu trabalhei ontem. Eu falei com meu amigo.

reading_aloud.translation: On Friday, Ana visited her family. She talked to her mother and helped her father. Then she prepared lunch. I worked at home. At night, we studied Portuguese and listened to Brazilian music. Everyone rested on Saturday.

answers.question: O que eles escutaram à noite?

speaking_practice.question: O que você estudou ontem?
speaking_practice.watch_for: Eu trabalhou ontem. → Eu trabalhei ontem. (Eu takes -ei.) Ela estudei ontem. → Ela estudou ontem. (Ela takes -ou.)

speaking_practice.question: Você trabalhou no sábado?
speaking_practice.watch_for: Eu trabalhou ontem. → Eu trabalhei ontem. (Eu takes -ei.) Ela estudei ontem. → Ela estudou ontem. (Ela takes -ou.)

speaking_practice.question: Com quem você conversou ontem?
speaking_practice.watch_for: Eu trabalhou ontem. → Eu trabalhei ontem. (Eu takes -ei.) Ela estudei ontem. → Ela estudou ontem. (Ela takes -ou.)

speaking_practice.question: Você preparou uma refeição ontem?
speaking_practice.watch_for: Eu trabalhou ontem. → Eu trabalhei ontem. (Eu takes -ei.) Ela estudei ontem. → Ela estudou ontem. (Ela takes -ou.)

speaking_practice.question: Você visitou alguém na semana passada?
speaking_practice.watch_for: Eu trabalhou ontem. → Eu trabalhei ontem. (Eu takes -ei.) Ela estudei ontem. → Ela estudou ontem. (Ela takes -ou.)

E_reading.translation: Last weekend Pedro traveled to another city. He bought a gift and walked downtown. His sister stayed home and studied Portuguese. I called Pedro on Sunday. We talked about the trip and planned a visit.

answers.question: O que a irmã de Pedro estudou?
Quando o narrador telefonou para Pedro?
answers.answer: Ele telefonou para Pedro no domingo.

F_written_production.model_text: No último fim de semana, Pedro viajou para outra cidade. Ele comprou um presente e caminhou no centro. Sua irmã ficou em casa e estudou português. Eu telefonei para Pedro no domingo. Nós conversamos sobre a viagem e planejamos uma visita.
F_written_production.assessment: Check length, topic relevance, at least three accurate uses of the target structure, and agreement. Personal details vary.

homework.acceptable_alternatives: A different accurate subject, name, or everyday example is acceptable in open speaking/writing tasks. For closed translation tasks, accept semantically equivalent natural Brazilian Portuguese with the target structure.
